title: Sprut reason-code registry
description: Format of registry/reason-codes.json (SPRUT-CLIENT-SPECIFICATION CF02, 8.3; 03-CONTRACTS 7). Reason codes are carried on the wire as plain strings equal to `code`.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code, UPPER_SNAKE_CASE. Never renamed or reused.

next_action.description: What the user should do next.

retryable.description: True if repeating the same request with the same inputs, without human action or a change on the host, can succeed (transient condition). Automatic retries are still bounded (03-CONTRACTS 4).

cli_exit_code.description: Exit code of the sprut CLI when a command ends with this reason code. Must exist in registry/exit-codes.json.

platforms.description: Client platforms that can emit the code: windows = Sprut Desktop, linux = sprut CLI. Listed in the order windows, linux.

spec_refs.description: Where the code is defined or used in technical_docs.
